label: Men and Women Can't Just Be Friends - Vocabulary

vocab.example: The study showed that attraction between friends can sometimes grow.
Their relationship stayed professional despite rumors.
They had a purely platonic friendship.
He perceived her message as a sign of interest.
The conference gave her an opportunity to meet new people.
Many people assume men and women cannot be just friends.
He had a misguided belief about their relationship.
They tried to estimate how many friendships involve attraction.
She was sensitive to his feelings.
She didn’t want to get involved with anyone at work.
He chose not to pursue a romantic relationship.
Opposite-sex friendships can become complicated.
One aspect of friendship is emotional support.
There was a mutual understanding between them.
Different expectations caused a conflict.
Both friends agreed not to tell anyone about the study.
The experiment required full confidentiality.
There is always a possibility of developing feelings.
An outside observer might think they were in love.
The conclusion of the study surprised everyone.
His words provoked a big argument.
There was a serious debate about friendships.
The magazine published a lurid story about them.
